rekeyNote: REPLACES acq-2026-09-21-checklistinsider-bowman-draft-sapphire-ladder-2025, which staged this same source ladder under setKey=bowman-draft. That was the wrong product key: 2025 Bowman Draft Sapphire is its own registered product, bowman-draft-sapphire (productSetKeys.ts:670, parent bowman-draft), and card_catalog already carries 4,751 rows under the hiq:baseball:2025:bowman-draft-sapphire: id prefix versus only 1,648 sapphire-parallel rows misfiled under hiq:baseball:2025:bowman-draft:. The '91% of sales sit under bowman-draft' evidence that justified the old package's key was itself a defect: a nightly job with a stale key mirror had been downgrading sapphire sales to bowman-draft; that job was fixed 2026-09-21 and a separate nightly move relocates ~8,761 sales bowman-draft -> bowman-draft-sapphire. The engine was verified directly (dist build, 2026-09-21): computeHobbyIqCardId + inferSetKeyFromTitle key a real '2025 Bowman Draft Sapphire ... #BDC-12 Gold Sapphire' title to bowman-draft-sapphire for both BDC- and CPA- card-number prefixes -- not bowman-draft.

A per-cardNumber point-check (263 queries, READ-ONLY, paced) fetched 51,848 existing rows total; of those, 4,751 already sit at the bowman-draft-sapphire: id prefix for this package's cardNumbers.

dedupMethod.keying: For every (cardNumber, parallel, printRun, isAuto) point in this package, the drop decision checked ONLY existing bowman-draft-sapphire: rows for a same-rung match (case-insensitive parallel, exact printRun and isAuto) -- rows under sibling setKeys (bowman-draft, bowman-chrome-sapphire, topps-chrome-sapphire, topps) were consulted for spelling comparison only, never for the drop decision, per instruction.
dedupMethod.spellingDiscoveryForcedARebuild: The FIRST dedup pass (against the OLD package's bare-Sapphire spelling, e.g. 'Gold Sapphire' for the BDC- base ladder) found EVERY one of the 1,410 rows already present under bowman-draft-sapphire -- because that setKey's own catalog rows do not use the bare-Sapphire spelling for the BDC- (non-auto) ladder. Measured directly (4,751 existing bowman-draft-sapphire rows for these 263 cardNumbers, grouped by printRun+isAuto+parallel, distinct-cardNumber counts): the BDC- base ladder's MAJORITY existing spelling is the bare COLOUR WORD alone ('Yellow' 200/200, 'Gold' 201/201, 'Orange' 200/200, 'Black' 200/200, 'Red' 200/200, 'Padparadscha' 200/200 cards), against a 63-card-per-rung '...Sapphire Refractor'-suffixed minority (the same fork the ORIGINAL bowman-draft-keyed package's manifest flagged, except that fork lives under bowman-draft-sapphire, not bowman-draft, and this package's own working spelling ('Gold Sapphire' etc, matching neither) was a THIRD, never-before-seen spelling that would have minted yet another fork. Rebuilt this package's non-auto BDC- rows to the bare-colour majority spelling before re-running dedup.
dedupMethod.autoRungsSpelling: The CPA-/SSA- AUTO ladders' majority existing spelling IS 'X Sapphire' (e.g. 'Orange Sapphire' 45/60 cards vs 'Orange Sapphire Refractors' 15/60; 'Red Sapphire' 45/60 vs 'Red Sapphire Refractors' 15/60; 'Gold Sapphire' 30/32; 'Black Sapphire' 30/30 sole spelling; 'Padparadscha Sapphire' 30/45 vs 'SuperFractor' 15/45; 'Green Sapphire' 33/33 supersets the 30-card 'Green Sapphire Refractor' subset exactly) -- this package's original 'X Sapphire' spelling for auto rungs was ALREADY the majority match, unchanged.
dedupMethod.result: 1,357 of the 1,410 candidate rows are rung-level twins of rows already resident under bowman-draft-sapphire once spelling is corrected to the majority form (not 404 -- the original 404 count was measured against the WRONG spelling, which under-detected true duplicates). 53 rows are genuinely new: the entire insert-sapphire-selections (SS-) ladder, 18 cards x up to 3 rungs each (Gold/Orange/Red; SS-7 has no Gold rung per the source page), which has NO existing catalog presence under any setKey at any spelling for these cardNumbers.
